result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: A debt buyer shall not bring suit to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The prohibition on suit is expressly conditional on expiration of the applicable limitations period.

claims.claim: Under the same condition, a debt buyer shall not initiate arbitration to collect the consumer debt.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

claims.claim: Under the same condition, a debt buyer shall not initiate another legal proceeding to collect the consumer debt.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The prohibition expressly includes other legal proceedings.

result.summary: Section 1788.56 supports all three prohibitions and the condition that the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
